title: Comparison of Nutritional Screening Tools in Liver Cirrhosis Patients
brief_summary: This study compares two nutritional screening questionnaires in cirrhotic patients. All patients will be assessed with both questionnaires, besides a complete nutritional assessment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with liver cirrhosis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with cognitive impairment or major psychiatric disorder.
* Lack of consent from the patient for inclusion in the study.
* Any patient who is not suitable based on the researcher's own judgement.
study_population: The cohort will be selected from admitted patients at the Hepatology ward of the Hospital.
